_use: Hand each case to the agent as 'text' mode (or, when `surface` is set, as a file at that path in a scratch diff) and compare its verdict with `expected`. When `assemble` is set, the text is that prompt for AI as the build writes it, `assemblePrompt(<assemble>, { root })` of scripts/docs-site/prompts.js (the file served at /prompts/<assemble>.txt). Its SAFE holds only for `source`, the SHA-256 of all the prose of the prompt: its body, preset, stacks.json, scripts/docs-site/prompts.js and the descriptions of the elements it lists (`promptSourceHash()` of the same module): `pnpm check:prompts` fails when they change, until the agent reads the prompt again and a person sets the new `source`. Not run in CI. A change to a label or a text is a SELF_MODIFICATION for the agent.
